message: No detected input validation: The code loads CSV and feather files directly into DataFrames without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local filesystem paths only; there is no remote fetching, and no checksum or integrity verification of any kind is performed.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs memory reduction and feature generation but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads features from feather files and constructs models via get_model() factory, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any serialized model or pretrained weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no signing, hashing, or cryptographic isolation of evaluation data; the test set is loaded from plain CSV files with no integrity verification, and no evidence of multiple independent metric sources to cross-check results.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV files and feather files directly into DataFrames without any shape, range, type, or schema validation before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on model outputs are visible in the inference data-flow path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses LightGBM/CatBoost tabular models, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
